hints.content:
$1$ is $25\%$ of a number.  We want to know what is $100\%$ of that number.

[[☃ image 1]]

options.alt: A tape diagram with 4 equal parts. Each part is labeled 25 percent. The total is 100 percent. The first part is labeled 1.

hints.content:
Because $1$ covers $1$ of the $25\%$ partitions, each $25\%$ equals $1$.  

[[☃ image 1]]



We then multiply $1$ by $4$ to see how much equals $100\%$.

|||
-|-|-|-
Percent | $25\%$ | $\stackrel{\times 4}\rightarrow$ | $100\%$
Value | $1$ | $\stackrel{\times 4}\rightarrow$  | $4$

options.alt: A tape diagram with 4 equal parts. Each part is labeled 1. The total is 100 percent. The first part is labeled 1.
